opening.argument: The title and opening question frame this as a collection of AskReddit stories about computer illiteracy. The examples concern mistaken computer use, not a transaction. The closing money-frog line mentions getting $200, but supplies no payment route, link, contact method, data request, or serious offer structure. Its placement alongside an optional request to subscribe fits the video's humorous presentation and ordinary channel engagement, rather than an attempt to obtain money or information from viewers.

citations.quote: What is the most computer illiterate thing you've witnessed?
You have been visited by the money frog. He says frog money to get $200 on test street.
If you are new to the channel, you can subscribe.
Or don't. Either way, have a great day you magnificent people.
